Anemoy JTRSY: BVI FSC-regulated tokenized fund share

applicabilityBasis.summary: JTRSY is an ownership share in the Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund, a pooled Treasury investment fund. Anemoy states that the token is a share certificate under BVI law and gives a legal claim to underlying fund assets. This is an actual fund ownership instrument, not a classification inferred from Treasury backing or yield alone. GENIUS Section 2(22)(B)(iii) excludes securities; nothing in the opened fund page establishes JTRSY as a permitted-issuer payment-stablecoin claim overriding that exclusion.

genius.notes: The primary product page describes pooled sub-six-month Treasury investment, daily redemption and USDC investment/redemption. It explicitly identifies ownership-share and share-certificate rights. BVI fund regulation is an issuer disclosure, not U.S. payment-stablecoin approval. No issuerEntity or issuerDomicile is set because the exact legal issuing vehicle is not identified in the opened token-specific material; Anemoy Limited in the site footer, the manager, and Janus Henderson the sub-adviser are not substituted for it. Securities applicability is independent of the unresolved exact company name.
